title: Local Minimax Risk for Stationary POMDP Policy Value under Rank Collapse
banked_reason: D0.5 tier=incremental below the fixed field floor; paper_score_ceiling 6.3 < 7.4, salvageable=false, no bounded improvement directive. Main validity gate confirms downgraded banking with unrepaired panel findings disclosed.
proof_attempt_summary: constructions, and progressively stronger persistence comparisons on the specified binary fiber; the graph records 22 proved NL nodes and seven verified cited nodes. D0.5 assigned incremental novelty below the fixed field floor, with no bounded same-scope lift, so the run stopped before Lean formalization. The exact remaining persistence region is 2/3 < B <= sqrt(1672951/27200), with three panel findings retained as unrepaired.
tldr: On a transparent controlled binary weak-reward stress family with a specified independent-fair start, stationary causal value has finite root-horizon risk but no common observed-score gradient. Regular stationary-HMM LAN does not supply the nonidentified persistence-ray transfer. The sharp risk is the minimax value of an infinite Gaussian geometric-ray experiment, with an original-trajectory all-estimator lower bound, uniform observable attainment and a terminating two-sided numerical certificate. A small-radius endpoint saddle supplies an exact constant and an \(O(T)\) attaining rule. The actual Hu--Wager raw partial-history evaluator has strictly larger scaled MSE throughout a nonempty local parameter region, with the central mean and radius used by the attaining rule disclosed. General-radius least-favorable persistence and projection sufficiency remain open.
gap: Hu--Wager gives stationary partially observed policy-evaluation rates, and Bennett--Kallus gives finite-horizon regular proximal efficiency. Bickel--Ritov supplies the direct stationary-HMM LAN framework; its regular identifiable inference regime does not supply likelihood-weighted transfer across the nonidentified persistence rays or their stationary causal target map. These results do not supply an original-record sharp constant at that fiber. The banked rank-free binary rate result leaves constants and limit laws unresolved.
fill: Derive likelihood-weighted Gaussian risk transfer over all original-record estimators, compute its minimax value with rational certificates and explicit reconstruction errors, and construct total observable attainters. Derive the raw evaluator\textquotesingle{}s full fixed-history local MSE and a strictly positive uniform gap on \(0<B<\sqrt{3/2}\). The small-radius branch gives an \(O(T)\) attaining rule, an evaluated constant and a consumer comparison.
